description: Build a limit buy or sell of a listed stock token against USDC (Base) or USDG (Robinhood Chain): an exact approve only when the allowance is short, then deposit + place. amount = the stock quantity in base units (18 decimals for wt tokens); price = USDC/USDG per 1 token. No fee to place. Returns unsigned transactions for the user to sign in their own wallet, in order; nothing is sent or signed here.
name: place_limit_order
title: Place a limit order (unsigned txs)
